papers.title: A snow-jet bridging mechanism driving the Afro-Asian summer monsoon precipitation dipole
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“青藏高原”：标题或摘要命中 tibetan plateau、plateau、monsoon、precipitation、drought，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: The Afro-Asian summer monsoon precipitation sustains billions of people across the two continents, and its variability strongly affects water supply, irrigation, and drought-flood risks. While this variability has been linked to air-sea interactions, its connection with land-surface signals remains unclear. Using large-ensemble snow perturbation experiments and information flow causal analysis, we show that reduced Tibetan Plateau snow cover (TPS) contributes to a dipole pattern in Afro-Asian summer monsoon precipitation: positive anomalies over tropical Africa and negative anomalies over South Asia. This relationship is modulated by an accelerated tropical easterly jet (TEJ). Reduced TPS enhances thermal heating, exciting an upper-level anticyclonic anomaly. The easterly flow along its southern flank intensifies the TEJ, enhancing moisture transport toward tropical Africa and reinforcing the low-level anticyclonic anomaly over South Asia, resulting in a dipole precipitation pattern. Since 2006, TPS extent has stayed below 9% (a transition after which the TPS-TEJ coupling substantially weakens), raising uncertainty in future projections of Afro-Asian monsoon under continued warming and TPS loss.

papers.title: Neogene birth of the Yangtze River: a synthesis of zircon U-Pb provenance data
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“青藏高原”：标题或摘要命中 tibetan plateau、plateau、climate、monsoon，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: The evolution of the Yangtze River is key to deciphering tectonic-climate-geomorphology coupling in East Asia, yet its integration age, whether Eocene, Miocene, or Quaternary, remains hotly contested. To constrain the timing of final Yangtze River integration, this study compiles 11,346 Phanerozoic zircon U-Pb ages from the Yangtze catchment, spanning multiple basins, orogenic belts, and modern river sediments. The results reveal that the diagnostic 45–35 Ma zircon U-Pb age peak from the upper reaches is absent from Paleogene strata in the middle-lower reaches, indicating that detritus from the upper Yangtze River had not yet reached the lower reaches during the Paleogene. However, Neogene strata in the Jianghan (25–18 Ma) and the East China Sea basins (20–10 Ma) show, for the first time, characteristic age peaks at 40–32, 20, and 18–16 Ma, which can be traced back to bedrock sources in the Jinsha and Dadu river catchments. These findings establish that the Yangtze River achieved its final integration during the Early Miocene, refuting Eocene and Quaternary models. Neogene fault reactivation (20–10 Ma) and monsoon intensification along the southeastern Tibetan Plateau generated the topographic relief and hydraulic power that drove river incision and transcontinental sediment routing.

papers.title: Strengthened relationship between August Laptev Sea ice retreat and September precipitation in Central China since 2005
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“青藏高原”：标题或摘要命中 plateau、climate、atmospher、ocean、precipitation，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Abstract The intensified interannual variability of September rainfall in Central China has led to increasingly frequent and devastating hydrological disasters over the past two decades. This study identifies the accelerated retreat of August Laptev Sea ice since 2005 as a critical, previously unrecognized precursor for September precipitation in Central China. Diagnostics show that post-2005 sea ice retreat and its heightened interannual variance substantially enhance local ice-ocean-atmosphere coupling compared with pre-2005. The resulting surface warming initiates a persistent “warm Siberia–cold North China” thermal dipole, which suppresses the meridional temperature gradient (MTG) over the Mongolian Plateau. This altered thermal gradient modulates transient eddy activity, driving an equatorward shift of the subtropical westerly jet through transient eddy–mean flow interaction, then strengthening the meridional secondary circulation. This configuration facilitates an anomalous anticyclone over the western North Pacific, with anomalous southwesterly flow on its western flank importing moisture across Central China’s southern boundary. Coupled with deep ascending motion, this process drives enhanced September rainfall. These findings underscore the evolving impact of Arctic cryospheric change on mid-latitude climate, providing valuable insights for seasonal forecasting and water resource management.

papers.title: Diagnosing region-specific flood influencing factors in a volcanic island using explainable machine learning
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“AI × 气候”：标题或摘要命中 machine learning、explainable、hydrolog、rainfall，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Abstract This study applies a grid-based, explainable machine learning framework to identify dominant flood-influencing factors under hydrologically heterogeneous conditions, using Jeju Island as a representative volcanic environment. Historical flood trace maps were integrated with multi-layer spatial datasets to classify flooded and non-flooded grid cells at a 100 m resolution using five tree-based algorithms. The models achieved recall and F1-scores of up to 0.86 and 0.78, respectively. Feature-importance and explainability analyses demonstrate that the dominance of flood-influencing factors varies across spatial contexts, with hydrometeorological conditions acting as the primary drivers and spatial exposure and proximity-based factors contributing in a region-specific manner. The results highlight diagnostic insights into the primary drivers of flooding and suggest that factors which may be underrepresented in conventional rainfall-centric assessments can exert substantial influences on flood occurrence.

papers.title: ENSO's Imprint on the Southern Ocean: Wind Waves Drive Surface Cross‐Frontal Flow
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“极地气候”：标题或摘要命中 southern ocean、ocean、teleconnection，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Abstract Tropical teleconnection associated with El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) is widely recognized for regulating multiple physical processes in the Southern Ocean. However, despite its influence on Southern Ocean wind patterns, the response of surface flow has received little attention. Here, we investigate surface flow in the Southern Ocean using surface‐drifting buoy trajectories collected during September 2022–May 2023 and November 2023–June 2024. Drifter observations exhibit significant cross‐frontal movements primarily driven by Stokes drift rather than Ekman velocity. The observations also show interannual variability, with strong poleward cross‐frontal flow in 2024 during a strong El Niño event. Further analyses over the past approximately 31 years indicate that ENSO teleconnection is the primary driver of this interannual variability. These findings provide a new perspective on how tropical teleconnection influences cross‐frontal flow via wind waves and highlight their potential role in tracer transport across fronts.
